utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring anything specific for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just whatever’s on the list is fine. If you need a hand, I can bring tape or a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can bring the list and I’ll grab tape too if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can probably do that. Just tell me what you need fixed, and I’ll try to keep track this time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, just point me to the repair and I’ll grab what we need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is picking up today - I heard a few more neighbors signed up this morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good, but I hope we’ve got enough hands and tools lined up before it gets any bigger.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I’m going to ask around tonight and make sure we’ve got the extra hands and the right tools before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Opal. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve still got a few spots to cover: the porch steps, the back gate latch, and the loose rail by the side path.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the porch steps first, then check the back gate latch and the side path rail.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’m spreading the word now. If you can lend a hand at the repair drive, I’ll make sure you get all the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that. Thank you, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send you the repair drive details right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’ve got the repair drive on my list and I’ll keep it organized. Tell me what you need from me first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just need the parts list and the first repair date.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll get the parts list together and set the first repair date next.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I help, could you confirm what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It’s the drive itself and the connector on the right side that keep cutting out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so it’s the drive itself and the right-side connector cutting out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check my calendar, but school pickup comes first for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No rush, Faye. Let me know after pickup, and I’ll keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara. I’ll check after pickup and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m a little behind on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s moving along - they’re collecting small appliance, furniture, and bike repairs over at the community center this Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive is covered?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, that repair drive is covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the repair drive with you, if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I might’ve mixed up the details, but I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem. We can sort it out together and see what actually needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll bring it up with the repair drive folks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep track of what they need on our side too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep it moving with them and let you know what comes back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up speed. I can swing by later and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’d help. There’s still a bit to sort out, so a second pair of eyes would be useful.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to have you bring the screws and the drill, and I’ll send the rest of the list over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll bring the screws and the drill. Just send me the rest when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I think I missed the update, but I can help if you tell me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the repair drive update: a few items changed, and I can send you the current list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, send me the current list and I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I’ve got a few tools I can bring by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Gus. Bring what you’ve got by, and I’ll keep the plan simple so we can sort the repairs out one by one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the tools by and we can tackle each repair one at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it, Quinn. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll help get the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks. I’ll spread the word and keep an eye out for anything else that comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep track and be ready when the next repair comes up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that if you point me to the right stack of tools. I’m happy to spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive stack is by the back shed, just left of the workbench. Tell people to check there first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it, I’ll point people to the stack by the back shed, just left of the workbench.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Cleo. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’ll make sure the neighbors who signed up get assigned cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll coordinate the assignments and keep the list tidy so we can move quickly once the supplies are in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just bring yourself, and maybe a pair of work gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll bring gloves and just show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help, but I need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I need the repair drive details and the school schedule, then I can coordinate the timing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I still need the repair drive details too before I can coordinate timing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Kira. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you really mean the repair drive this Saturday? What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I mean this Saturday. I can help fix whatever needs attention, like loose fixtures, broken handles, or anything small we can handle together.
